_comment: Texas has no state income tax.
name: Texas
notes: Texas has no personal income tax, and a 2019 amendment to the Texas Constitution bars lawmakers from adding one without a statewide vote.
The state makes up the money elsewhere: property taxes in Texas are among the highest in the country, so a bigger paycheck doesn't always mean a cheaper life.
Texas has no state disability insurance program that takes money from your check. For most Texas employees, only federal tax and FICA come out.
This works as a salary or hourly paycheck calculator for Texas. Switch between them at the top of the calculator.
